Pre-magic monster category. The historical name foregrounds danger to humans, but current membership is determined by world ontology rather than by whether an individual is presently attacking a human.
Pre-magic objectively evidenced deity category. The historical name foregrounds being worshipped; worship is not the live membership criterion.
Pre-magic female-deity category built historically from the older deity name plus Female.

Pre-magic mana concept known as a godly/divine magical phenomenon or resource, before ordinary people could use magic directly. This is distinct from later setting-specific technical Mana concepts such as Yona-world Mana.
Ordinary pre-magic meditation practice. The historical name 'waking sleep' is descriptive etymology, not a requirement that meditation literally satisfy both Awake and Sleep.
Human Kind. The current draft historical name reuses Animal and foregrounds knowledge; exact classifier remains world-ontology work.
Cat Kind. Draft historical wording treats it as a small animal; this etymology is not a live classifier.
Water material Kind. Draft historical wording foregrounds ordinary liquid matter; exact material identity is not derived from current phase.
Body Kind. Draft historical wording foregrounds living matter; the fossilized name remains the body word after later state changes.
Hand Kind. Draft historical wording foregrounds a grasping body part; exact anatomy belongs to the world ontology.
Sound/acoustic-phenomenon Kind. Draft historical wording foregrounds what is heard; exact physical classifier is deferred.
